title: Natanz Chahartaq
description: A surviving four-doored, domed structure of presumed Sasanian date (i.e., a čahārṭāq) whose original function is uncertain. Schippman rejected earlier identifications as a fire temple of the basis of descriptive conflation with another site, but does not specifically address this structure's function.
